text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Long ago.
In an era where knights clad themselves in silver armor and forged countless legends.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A knight who wandered long without pledging fealty met a young king during his travels.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Though the king was inexperienced, he understood the worth of the knight's sword better than anyone and appointed him to high honor.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Before long, the knight vowed fealty to the king as his one and only lord. It is said that through thick and thin, not for a single moment did he ever leave the king's side—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And the Western armor said to have been worn by that very knight... is coming to the local art space today...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the armor of a legendary knight...! Sounds like something you'd totally love, Durandal-chan!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have waited so long since the announcement! Ah, I cannot wait to see it!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, regarding the armor...
Actually, we received a report that it went missing, so the exhibition has been canceled...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhh—!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-chan, cheer up~.
Well, you were really looking forward to it, so I get it...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Here, it's just plain hot water, but would you like some?
...I'll stay by your side until you feel better.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... If only I could have seen it just once...!
Armor... where in the world did you go...?!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: —It walked away, back to its master.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, who might you be...?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Ah, forgive me...! Seeing that you young ladies were also looking forward to the armor exhibit, I couldn't help but speak up...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly...
What do you mean by "it walked away"?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Haha... Truth be told, there has always been such a rumor surrounding that armor.

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps borne from the knight's profound loyalty, night after night it begins to walk, wandering in search of its lord..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Even in death, seeking to remain by its lord's side...?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Yes... One could dismiss it as a mere common ghost story. But when thinking of the legend that knight left behind, perhaps... or so one might wonder.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...I understand.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, too, am someone searching for a lord to devote my loyalty to...!
If, if such a person was finally found, only to be torn apart by cruel fate...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I would go searching for them too...!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Fufu, quite right. So young lady, let us not be disheartened, but instead pray for its safe journey. ...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Durandal-chan, what are you getting ready for? Are you heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the story from that old man earlier.
You really are concerned about it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes! Hearing the tale of a knight true to his chivalric loyalty... I cannot simply stand by in silence!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...I want to find it. Even if I do not know whether the story is true or not...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The loyalty residing within that armor deserves to be rewarded!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I will surely track down the armor, reunite it with its lord... and allow it to rest in peace!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to lend my aid!
That is the proper courtesy due to a fellow knight who cherishes loyalty!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Then I'm coming with you too!
I'm just really glad to see you cheered up, Durandal-chan.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Me too.
Would you let me help as well?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you.
...Let the knight's grand adventure begin...!

Rumors of the "missing" armor spread like wildfire.
Along with the bold declaration of a student claiming she would track it down—
choice_data_list: (...It would be pretty interesting if it turned out to be real.)
(...It would be pretty interesting if it turned out to be real.)

text_block_list.text: ...And so, I decided to discreetly keep an eye on her.
